title: 逃げゆく風を追いかけて

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Bright, you're gonna win this Derby! I just know it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Dear me… Ryan, you sound terribly assured.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby, the greatest challenge of the Classic Triple Crown approaches. Mejiro Ryan's brimming with confidence.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You should be just as confident as I am. The track at Tokyo is practically made for you, Bright. 2,400 meters is just the right length!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It's got the longest straight of all the racecourses! That means you'll be able to charge ahead no problem!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: The track is wide, too, so you won't get blocked. If you just hit the track like always, then…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan may be full of cheer, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Perchance, are you… concerned about something?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm frank about my worries. While it's true this track suits her well, I'm still concerned that she can't control the pace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The pace chasers back at the Satsuki Sho were no joke. If Mejiro Bright relies too much on the final stretch, assuming things are in her favor…
choice_data_list: You might run into a nasty surprise.
You might run into a nasty surprise.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Urk! You're not wrong… In fact, there's an Umamusume here who stood out to me. Kinda reminded me of Ines…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You'll be in trouble if you don't pay attention to the front runners and pace chasers. It's rare, but front runners sometimes win the Derby too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That's right. I believe something similar happened the year you ran, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You remember?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Of course I do. The front runner who won was a dear classmate of yours, was she not?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's right. The Umamusume who beat Mejiro Ryan at the Derby was her own roommate, Ines Fujin.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Urgh… Don't reopen that old wound… I was so bummed by that result… It really hurt!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But past scars don't spell the end of your story. I was able to come back better than ever because of all the iron I pumped!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I wanna put Bright through the same lesson I had!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hold on for a sec! I'll be right back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: P-pardon? Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan sprints away at an incredible speed, but she's back in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hello-lo, Bright! ♪ I'm here to have some fun!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, you must be Ines! I'm positively elated to make your acquaintance.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Same here! Ryan's been going on about you since forever!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Her love and affection for you are the real deal! She's practically drowning in love!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: S-stop, Ines. That's so embarrassing…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Mejiro Bright begins her training by partner running with Ines Fujin.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe, catch up, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff… The distance between us keeps increasing… I suppose I have to accelerate a tad…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thump, thump, thump, thump!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Heehee! That's what I want to see! Now, here comes the final stretch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoooosh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh no… I can't push ahead! Normally, I can close the gap, but this time…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… Trainer, what happened?
choice_data_list: I see. She's the perfect opponent for you.
I see. She's the perfect opponent for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The perfect opponent…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There are various types of front runners. Ines Fujin is one who controls every aspect of the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She sets the pace from the beginning, condenses the pack in the middle of the race, and finally sprints forward with all her energy right at the end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In other words, the type of runner that Mejiro Bright's least compatible with.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You're right, Trainer. While Bright and I both save our energy for that final spurt, Ines is totally different.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I could see it clear as day, watching them run just now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I understand too. I'm so grateful to have had the chance to run with you, Ines.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I also believe, if you were to help coach me, it would go a long way in preparing me for the race ahead.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Right, right! You and I training together is a recipe for awesome! Plus, I'd do anything for Ryan's sworn sis.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Ines. I knew I could count on you to spot.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The ability to borrow aid from others is more proof of our Mejiro power, no?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I can receive aid not just from other Mejiros, but also from the Umamusume we befriend.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ines, I'm looking forward to becoming your protege.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I feel so reassured—as if I've just gained another big sis!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: For sure! I'll totally play big sis for you! I've actually got two little sisters back home.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Now then, you two, let's hit the track! Trainer, whenever you're ready!
choice_data_list: Right. Let's test out a few different strategies.
Right. Let's test out a few different strategies.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the race approaching, we run several mock derbies. Before we know it…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our strategy is perfectly formed. Mejiro Bright should be able to hold her own against even the most oppressive front runner.
